$comment: Pinned third-party rule sets fetched by scripts/fetch_rulesets.py. A git entry pins a tag and the commit it must resolve to; an archive entry pins a URL and the SHA-256 of the file. Bump a pin in its own commit, with the upstream release notes linked in the message.

rulesets.name: ubl-2.1
rulesets.description: OASIS Universal Business Language (UBL) 2.1 OS schemas (ISO/IEC 19845:2015): the Invoice and CreditNote document schemas and the common component schemas they import. The syntax every EN 16931 UBL invoice, and every SEF invoice, must be valid against.
rulesets.license: Copyright (c) OASIS Open 2001-2013, under the OASIS IPR Policy: the notices (in UBL-2.1.html) permit copying and distributing the unmodified documents; they may not be modified. UBL-xmldsig-core-schema-2.1.xsd is the W3C XML Signature schema (W3C Software License) with its DTD identifiers removed by OASIS.
rulesets.notice: Official package listed in the EN 16931 validation artefacts (ubl/schema/README.md) as the schemas the CEN rules are written for. Only the schemas needed for Invoice and CreditNote are extracted, together with UBL-2.1.html, which carries the OASIS notices. Release notes and the full package: https://docs.oasis-open.org/ubl/os-UBL-2.1/

rulesets.name: en16931
rulesets.description: CEN/TC 434 EN 16931 validation artefacts for the UBL 2.1 syntax binding: Schematron sources, the compiled XSLT, official example and unit-test invoices.
rulesets.license: European Union Public Licence (EUPL) v1.2, see LICENSE.txt
rulesets.notice: Release notes: https://github.com/ConnectingEurope/eInvoicing-EN16931/releases/tag/validation-1.3.17. The XSLT is the official build shipped by CEN/TC 434 and is executed as-is; it is never edited.

rulesets.name: peppol-bis-billing-3
rulesets.description: Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 validation rules (Schematron sources), the CEN rules as bundled by OpenPeppol, official example invoices and the OpenPeppol unit-test files.
rulesets.license: Copyright OpenPeppol AISBL; EN 16931 content reproduced with permission from CEN. The repository ships no license file; the terms are stated in guide/bis/introduction.adoc. The files are used locally for validation only and are never redistributed by this project.
rulesets.notice: OpenPeppol publishes only Schematron sources (no compiled XSLT) for BIS Billing 3.0; SEF Kopilot compiles them to XSLT with the pinned iso-schematron pipeline on first use and caches the result (see docs/adr/0005-schematron-runner.md). Published specification: https://docs.peppol.eu/poacc/billing/3.0/

rulesets.name: iso-schematron
rulesets.description: ISO Schematron "skeleton" reference implementation (Rick Jelliffe and contributors): the XSLT 2.0 pipeline that compiles Schematron sources into validating XSLT producing SVRL. Used to compile the Peppol BIS rules, which OpenPeppol publishes only as Schematron.
rulesets.license: MIT License, Copyright (c) 2004-2010 Rick Jelliffe and Academia Sinica Computing Centre, Taiwan; see LICENSE
rulesets.notice: The maintainers archived the repository in October 2020; the tag 2020-10-01 is its final state. ph-schematron ships a version of these XSLTs, and the official EN 16931 XSLT states it was created with it, so compiling the Peppol rules with them keeps our reports in the conventions of the official XSLT (see docs/adr/0005-schematron-runner.md).
